name: @kpozin/sprawl-guard
description: Node.js wrapper for the sprawl-guard CLI.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir .. exec tsc -p sprawl-guard/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vp pack
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm --dir .. exec tsc -p sprawl-guard/tsconfig.json && node --test ".test-dist/lib/*.test.js"
